files.description: EHI Schema Definition user manual (7-page PDF). Describes the BREH package, export format (JSON), scope (all EHI per 45 CFR 171.102 except images), and how sites can customize the national schema.
2023 national EHI export schema (JSON). Defines 296 patient files/tables with ~8,221 field definitions and 538 pointer/reference files. Initial schema version.
2024 national EHI export schema (JSON). Defines 298 patient files/tables with ~8,274 field definitions and 542 pointer/reference files. Added 2 new files vs 2023.
2025 national EHI export schema (JSON, latest version). Defines 301 patient files/tables with 8,415 field definitions and 548 pointer/reference files. Added 3 new files vs 2024.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script. Parses all 3 BREH schema files and produces queryable JSON outputs (files catalog, pointer files, field types, schema diffs, coverage stats).
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input/output descriptions, known parsing limitations.
Overview of all 3 schema versions with metadata, file counts, and field counts.
Complete catalog of all 301 patient files/tables from the 2025 schema with all 8,415 field definitions including types, constraints, pointer references, and value sets.
All 548 reference/lookup tables with their field references, used to resolve pointer-type fields in the patient files.
Field type distribution across the 2025 schema (8,415 fields total) with sample fields per type.
Version-to-version diffs showing added files and field count changes between 2023→2024 and 2024→2025.
Parsing accounting (3/3 files parsed, 0 failures) plus domain categorization of all 301 files across 11 categories.
